prose.subject: Invoice INV-46961 and Payout Account Update
prose.body:
Hi Felix,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to confirm the recent administrative changes on our end regarding payment processing. Our finance team has recently added a new payout account designated as gallowaylegal79-treasury.testnet. This new address has been formally linked to our primary domain, galloway-legal.example, to ensure seamless integration with your automated payment systems.

Please verify that this new account string, gallowaylegal79-treasury.testnet, is correctly configured in your vendor management portal to avoid any delays in future transactions. We have updated our internal records to reflect this change, and we believe this will streamline our settlement process for upcoming billing cycles.

Attached to this email is invoice INV-46961 for your review and processing. The total amount due is 8749.18 USDC. As per our standard terms, payment is due within fourteen days of receipt. Kindly ensure the funds are sent to the new account mentioned above to maintain consistency with our updated treasury structure.

If you have any questions regarding the new account linkage or the invoice details, please do not hesitate to reach out. I can be contacted directly via this thread for any clarifications needed.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,

Priya Okafor
Senior Financial Coordinator
Galloway Legal
